Tej Pratap Yadav’s Defeat: From Rebellion to 4th Place | Bihar Election 2025
In Bihar Assembly Election 2025, Lalu Yadav’s elder son Tej Pratap Yadav faced a shocking defeat from Mahua seat under his new party Janshakti Janta Dal (JJD), finishing in 4th position. This video breaks down:
His earlier wins from Mainpuri (2014, 2019) & Mahua (2015, 2020).
Expulsion from RJD in May 2025 – What triggered it?
How he formed JJD with ‘Blackboard’ symbol & allied with 5 small parties.
Rabri Devi’s emotional support – “Dil se beta hai” but no campaigning.
